titles.title: registerTemplate accepts a well-formed template
registerTemplate rejects id collision
registerTemplate rejects missing inputSchema
registerTemplate rejects empty produces
registerTemplate rejects missing description
registerTemplate: family=aggregate without isAggregator flag is rejected
registerTemplate: isAggregator without family=aggregate is rejected
registerTemplate: family=aggregate AND isAggregator:true is accepted
registerBuiltinTemplates registers exactly 27 builtins (7 code + 5 data + 8 infra + 1 generic + 6 docs) without collision
registerBuiltinTemplates is idempotent (latch prevents double-register)
every per-target subset has its own aggregator
getTemplatesForTarget(code) returns 7 code templates (6 leaf + 1 planner)
getTemplatesForTarget(data) returns 5 data templates
getTemplatesForTarget(infra) returns 8 infra templates
getTemplatesForTarget(docs) returns 6 docs templates (5 leaf + 1 planner)
getTemplatesForTarget(generic) returns the FULL catalog (INV-4 permits cross-target)
every builtin template has a syntactically valid inputSchema (Ajv compiles)
every builtin template produces non-empty string entries
every builtin template id namespaces its target as the leading prefix
every builtin template description is at least one sentence (>= 20 chars)
aggregator templates produce exactly ['report']
every builtin template's scopeRef lists exactly the kinds of scope its family accepts, and the catalog shows the planner those kinds only
a plan whose task carries a kind of scope its family does not accept fails validation with the task, the kind and the accepted kinds
